what_it_does: Uses large language models to improve the design of computer processor chips through a smarter optimization process. Instead of traditional automatic search algorithms, this method leverages LLMs' understanding of hardware design principles to generate better initial candidates and improve the predictive models that guide the search. The system explores millions of possible chip designs while optimizing for competing goals (speed, power, area) and incorporates expert hardware design knowledge to navigate the vast design space more effectively.
